description: Render one preview. Like local compose-ai-tools, the default semantics observation is token-frugal; request observe=png for pixels, observe=svg for the compose/figma-svg vector export as SVG source, or observe=scroll-png / observe=scroll-svg for the full-page capture of a scrollable screen rather than the viewport crop. Watch face previews also accept structured 'complications', 'watchFace', 'ambient', 'previewTime' / 'clockEpochMillis', and 'wfRenderer' ('dwf-rc' or 'dwf-apk'). 'watchFace' is the state the preview's own face is drawn in, never a face of its own: 'ambient', 'previewTime' (HH:mm, HH:mm:ss or epoch millis), 'clockEpochMillis', 'is24Hour', sensor values ('batteryPercent', 'stepCount', 'heartRate', ...), 'configurations' (UserConfiguration id to option) and 'themeColors'. Any other key, such as 'xml' or 'designId', is refused; a UI Builder design is seen on the real runtime in its Native pane. 'dwf-apk' runs the Android watch-face runtime and is refused with catalog_native_render_disabled where this server has turned that off; the default is then 'dwf-rc'; see each preview's watchFaceRenderers. Overrides, other observations and fresh renders require live grant scope; without it, a call with no overrides returns the published snapshot (as resources/read does).

token.description: A grant token from poll_access, when you cannot set the X-Compose-Preview-Token header yourself — an MCP client fixes its headers at connect time, so this is how a token approved during this session is used in it. Prefer the header where you control it.

watchFace.description: The state the preview's own face is drawn in; not a face of its own.

configurations.description: UserConfiguration id to option id or value

name: catalog_render_preview

imageUrl.description: Short-lived signed https URL of the rendered PNG, on a host with a public origin.
